sentences.en: The separatists seem to be convinced of their racial superiority.
sentences.zh: 分离主义者似乎确信他们的种族优越性。

sentences.en: Coated vascular stents didn't prove their superiority over bare metal vascular stents.
sentences.zh: 涂层血管支架未能证明其优于裸金属血管支架。

sentences.en: Liisa had a problem with Markku constantly trying to exploit his superiority.
sentences.zh: 丽萨对马库克总是试图利用他的优势感到困扰。

senses.zh: 优越性，优势；优越感，高人一等的感觉
